relation_kinds.translation: proposed translation correspondence; not a certified dictionary sense

editorial_review.scope: All 18 verses reread in both pinned texts.
notes: Gen 13:3–4: the resumed destination construction across the verse boundary is retained; supplied copula belongs to the construct phrase contextually.
Gen 13:5–6: the possessive existence construction and inability of the land to bear the group correspond to French idioms.
Gen 13:9–11: elliptical conditional motion and separation from one another are kept distinct from lexical meanings of left, right and brother.
Gen 13:14: directional suffixes are associated with the coordinated French directional expressions.
Gen 13:17–18: direct object in French replaces Hebrew preposition, and verbal tent idiom retains an implicit possessive attachment.
editorial_review.limitations: Both passes performed by the same editor; no independent dictionary-sense verification; publication checks deferred.
